examples.en: My middle-aged neighbor jogs around the park every morning.
examples.zh: 我那位中年鄰居每天早上都繞著公園慢跑。

examples.en: The survey asked middle-aged adults about their sleep habits.
examples.zh: 這項調查詢問中年人的睡眠習慣。

examples.en: A middle-aged man at the counter helped us choose a gift.
examples.zh: 櫃檯一位中年男士幫我們挑選禮物。

examples.en: I ordered a strawberry milkshake with my burger.
examples.zh: 我點了一杯草莓奶昔配漢堡。

examples.en: The milkshake was so thick that I could hardly use the straw.
examples.zh: 這杯奶昔太濃稠，我幾乎無法用吸管喝。

examples.en: Would you like a chocolate milkshake or a cup of tea?
examples.zh: 你想要巧克力奶昔還是一杯茶？

examples.en: We walked along the beach in the moonlight.
examples.zh: 我們在月光下沿著海灘散步。

examples.en: The moonlight came through the window and lit the room.
examples.zh: 月光從窗戶照進來，照亮了房間。

examples.en: The lake looked silver under the moonlight.
examples.zh: 湖面在月光下看起來一片銀白。

examples.en: My grandfather has a gray moustache and wears a straw hat.
examples.zh: 我爺爺留著灰色的小鬍子，戴著一頂草帽。

examples.en: He shaved off his moustache before the job interview.
examples.zh: 他在面試前把小鬍子刮掉了。

examples.en: The actor wore a fake moustache in the school play.
examples.zh: 那位演員在學校的戲劇裡貼了假的小鬍子。

examples.en: The classroom has movable desks, so we can change the layout.
examples.zh: 這間教室有可移動的課桌，所以我們可以改變座位排法。

examples.en: A movable wall divides the large hall into two rooms.
examples.zh: 一道活動隔牆把大廳分成兩間房間。

examples.en: These movable shelves are easy to push around the store.
examples.zh: 這些可移動的架子很容易在店裡推動。

examples.en: The naturalist spent ten years studying birds in the mountains.
examples.zh: 這位博物學家花了十年在山裡研究鳥類。

examples.en: Our class listened to a naturalist talk about wild flowers.
examples.zh: 我們班聽一位博物學家講野花。

examples.en: As a young naturalist, she kept a notebook of every insect she saw.
examples.zh: 身為年輕的自然研究者，她把看到的每一種昆蟲都記在筆記本裡。

examples.en: The naval base is located on the east coast of the island.
examples.zh: 海軍基地位於島嶼的東岸。

examples.en: Her father is a naval officer who often travels abroad.
examples.zh: 她的父親是海軍軍官，經常出國。

examples.en: Tourists can visit the naval museum on weekends.
examples.zh: 遊客週末可以參觀海軍博物館。

examples.en: Expensive shoes are not necessarily better than cheap ones.
examples.zh: 昂貴的鞋子不一定比便宜的好。

examples.en: A high score does not necessarily mean you understand the lesson.
examples.zh: 分數高不一定代表你理解了這一課。

examples.en: The clerk said the sale would not necessarily last until Sunday.
examples.zh: 店員說這次特賣不一定會持續到星期日。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to be kind to the newcomer in our class.
examples.zh: 老師請我們對班上的新同學友善一點。

examples.en: As a newcomer to the office, she asked many questions.
examples.zh: 身為辦公室的新人，她問了很多問題。

examples.en: The club welcomes every newcomer with a free snack.
examples.zh: 社團會用一份免費點心歡迎每位新成員。

examples.en: The newscaster read the weather report in a calm voice.
examples.zh: 新聞主播用平穩的聲音播報天氣。

examples.en: My aunt works as a newscaster for a local television station.
examples.zh: 我阿姨在一家地方電視台擔任新聞主播。

examples.en: The newscaster thanked the viewers and ended the program.
examples.zh: 新聞主播感謝觀眾後結束了節目。

examples.en: The test was difficult; nonetheless, most students passed.
examples.zh: 這次考試很難，儘管如此，大多數學生還是及格了。

examples.en: It rained all day. We had a great time nonetheless.
examples.zh: 雨下了一整天，我們仍然玩得很開心。

examples.en: The price is low, but the quality is nonetheless excellent.
examples.zh: 價格低廉，但品質依然極佳。

examples.en: We took a nonstop flight from Taipei to Tokyo.
examples.zh: 我們搭乘從台北直飛東京的直達班機。

examples.en: The nonstop noise from the street kept me awake.
examples.zh: 街上不停的噪音讓我睡不著。

examples.en: There is a nonstop bus to the airport every thirty minutes.
examples.zh: 每三十分鐘就有一班直達機場的公車。

examples.en: The band played nonstop for two hours.
examples.zh: 樂團不停地演奏了兩個小時。

examples.en: We talked nonstop all the way home.
examples.zh: 我們一路聊個不停直到回家。

examples.en: This train runs nonstop from the city to the airport.
examples.zh: 這班火車從市區直達機場。

examples.en: The wind is blowing from the northeast now.
examples.zh: 現在風從東北方吹來。

examples.en: Our hotel is in the northeast of the city.
examples.zh: 我們的飯店位在市區的東北部。

examples.en: Heavy rain is expected in the northeast this weekend.
examples.zh: 預計本週末東北部會下大雨。

examples.en: The northeast coast is famous for its rocky cliffs.
examples.zh: 東北海岸以岩石峭壁聞名。

examples.en: We live in the northeast corner of the island.
examples.zh: 我們住在島嶼的東北角。

examples.en: A northeast wind brought cool air to the area.
examples.zh: 東北風為這個地區帶來涼爽的空氣。

examples.en: The storm is moving toward the northwest.
examples.zh: 風暴正朝西北方移動。

examples.en: Our school is in the northwest of the town.
examples.zh: 我們學校在鎮上的西北部。

examples.en: Farmers in the northwest are waiting for the spring rain.
examples.zh: 西北部的農夫正在等待春雨。

examples.en: The northwest side of the mountain gets less sun.
examples.zh: 山的西北側日照比較少。

examples.en: They bought a house in a northwest suburb of the city.
examples.zh: 他們在城市的西北郊區買了一間房子。

examples.en: A cold northwest wind blew across the field.
examples.zh: 一陣冰冷的西北風吹過田野。

examples.en: The word happiness is a noun, but the word happy is an adjective.
examples.zh: happiness 這個字是名詞，而 happy 是形容詞。

examples.en: Please underline every noun in the sentence.
examples.zh: 請把句子中的每個名詞畫上底線。

examples.en: A noun can be the subject of a sentence.
examples.zh: 名詞可以當作句子的主詞。

examples.en: She plans to study nursing at a medical university.
examples.zh: 她打算在醫學大學學護理。

examples.en: Nursing is a hard job, but it helps many people.
examples.zh: 護理是一份辛苦的工作，卻能幫助許多人。

examples.en: My sister has worked in nursing for more than ten years.
examples.zh: 我姊姊從事護理工作已經超過十年。

examples.en: My grandmother lives in a nursing home near the park.
examples.zh: 我奶奶住在公園附近的護理之家。

examples.en: The nursing staff were kind to every patient.
examples.zh: 護理人員對每位病人都很親切。

examples.en: He is a nursing student at the local college.
examples.zh: 他是當地學院的護理系學生。

examples.en: This backpack is made of strong nylon.
examples.zh: 這個後背包是用堅韌的尼龍做的。

examples.en: She bought a pair of nylon socks for the trip.
examples.zh: 她為這趟旅行買了一雙尼龍襪。

examples.en: Nylon dries faster than cotton after you wash it.
examples.zh: 尼龍洗過後比棉乾得快。

examples.en: Oh, I forgot to bring my umbrella.
examples.zh: 噢，我忘了帶傘。

examples.en: Oh, that's a great idea! Let's try it.
examples.zh: 哦，這個點子真棒！我們試試看吧。

examples.en: Oh, are you the new teacher from Canada?
examples.zh: 哦，你就是從加拿大來的新老師嗎？

examples.en: She dreams of winning an Olympic medal one day.
examples.zh: 她夢想有一天能贏得奧運獎牌。

examples.en: The Olympic Games are held every four years.
examples.zh: 奧運會每四年舉辦一次。

examples.en: Our swimming coach is a former Olympic athlete.
examples.zh: 我們的游泳教練是前奧運選手。

senses.zh: 單方面的；一面倒的；片面的

examples.en: The game was one-sided, and our team won easily.
examples.zh: 這場比賽呈現一面倒，我們隊輕鬆獲勝。

examples.en: It is unfair to make a one-sided decision without asking others.
examples.zh: 不問別人就單方面做決定是不公平的。

examples.en: His one-sided story did not tell us what really happened.
examples.zh: 他片面的說法並沒有告訴我們實際發生了什麼事。

examples.en: Could you pass me the can opener?
examples.zh: 可以把開罐器遞給我嗎？

examples.en: There is a bottle opener in the second drawer.
examples.zh: 第二個抽屜裡有一支開瓶器。

examples.en: The singer was the opener for tonight's concert.
examples.zh: 這位歌手是今晚演唱會的開場表演者。

examples.en: The opening of the new library was on Monday.
examples.zh: 新圖書館在星期一開幕。

examples.en: There is a small opening in the fence for the cat.
examples.zh: 圍籬上有一個給貓進出的小開口。

examples.en: The company has an opening for a sales assistant.
examples.zh: 這家公司有一個業務助理的職缺。

examples.en: The opening scene of the movie was very funny.
examples.zh: 這部電影的開場一幕非常有趣。

examples.en: Our opening hours are from nine to six.
examples.zh: 我們的營業時間是九點到六點。

examples.en: The principal gave an opening speech at the ceremony.
examples.zh: 校長在典禮上致開場詞。

examples.en: You ought to drink more water on hot days.
examples.zh: 天氣熱的時候，你應該多喝水。

examples.en: We ought to leave now if we want to catch the train.
examples.zh: 如果想趕上火車，我們現在就該出發了。

examples.en: Students ought not to be late for class.
examples.zh: 學生不應該上課遲到。

examples.en: The doctor told him that he was a little overweight.
examples.zh: 醫生告訴他體重有點過重。

examples.en: My suitcase was overweight, so I paid an extra fee.
examples.zh: 我的行李箱超重，所以多付了一筆費用。

examples.en: Eating too many sweets can make children overweight.
examples.zh: 吃太多甜食可能讓孩子變得過重。

examples.en: We watched the sunset over the Pacific coast.
examples.zh: 我們在太平洋沿岸看日落。

examples.en: Many islands in the Pacific region are popular with tourists.
examples.zh: 太平洋地區的許多島嶼很受遊客歡迎。

examples.en: The ship will cross the Pacific Ocean next month.
examples.zh: 這艘船下個月將橫越太平洋。

examples.en: She has a part-time job at a bookstore.
examples.zh: 她在書店有一份兼職工作。

examples.en: Many college students look for part-time work in the summer.
examples.zh: 許多大學生在暑假找兼職工作。

examples.en: The café needs a part-time cook on weekends.
examples.zh: 這家咖啡廳週末需要一位兼職廚師。

examples.en: He works part-time so that he can study at night.
examples.zh: 他兼職工作，這樣晚上就能讀書。

examples.en: My mother teaches part-time at a language school.
examples.zh: 我媽媽在語言學校兼課。

examples.en: Would you like to work part-time or full-time?
examples.zh: 你想兼職還是全職工作？

examples.en: In the phrase a broken window, the word broken is a participle.
examples.zh: 在「a broken window」這個詞組中，broken 是一個分詞。

examples.en: A present participle usually ends in ing.
examples.zh: 現在分詞通常以 ing 結尾。

examples.en: Our English teacher explained how to use a participle.
examples.zh: 英文老師說明了如何使用分詞。

examples.en: I am particularly interested in the history of Taiwan.
examples.zh: 我對台灣的歷史特別感興趣。

examples.en: The weather was not particularly good during our trip.
examples.zh: 我們旅行期間天氣不是特別好。

examples.en: Wear warm clothes, particularly if you go out at night.
examples.zh: 要穿暖一點，尤其是在晚上外出的時候。

examples.en: We accept payment by credit card or cash.
examples.zh: 我們接受信用卡或現金付款。

examples.en: The first payment is due on the fifth of next month.
examples.zh: 第一期款項在下個月五日到期。

examples.en: Please make your payment by bank transfer before Friday.
examples.zh: 請在星期五之前以銀行轉帳付款。

examples.en: A pink petal fell onto my notebook.
examples.zh: 一片粉紅色的花瓣落在我的筆記本上。

examples.en: This flower has five white petals around a yellow center.
examples.zh: 這朵花有五片白色花瓣圍著黃色的花心。

examples.en: Children threw rose petals along the path at the wedding.
examples.zh: 孩子們在婚禮上沿路撒玫瑰花瓣。

examples.en: The postal service will be closed on Monday.
examples.zh: 郵政服務星期一休息。

examples.en: Please write your postal code on the envelope.
examples.zh: 請在信封上寫下你的郵遞區號。

examples.en: A postal worker delivered the package to our door.
examples.zh: 一位郵務人員把包裹送到我們家門口。

senses.zh: 無力的；無能為力的；無權的

examples.en: I felt powerless when I could not help my friend.
examples.zh: 當我幫不上朋友的忙時，我覺得無能為力。

examples.en: The villagers were powerless against the flood.
examples.zh: 村民在洪水面前無能為力。

examples.en: Since the visitor had no ticket, the guard was powerless to admit him.
examples.zh: 由於訪客沒有票，警衛無權讓他進入。

examples.en: Walking to school is preferable to taking a crowded bus.
examples.zh: 走路上學比搭擁擠的公車更好。

examples.en: A quiet room is preferable for studying.
examples.zh: 安靜的房間比較適合讀書。

examples.en: Fresh fruit is preferable to candy as a snack.
examples.zh: 新鮮水果比糖果更適合當點心。

examples.en: The manager is presently in a meeting.
examples.zh: 經理目前正在開會。

examples.en: My brother is presently studying in Canada.
examples.zh: 我哥哥目前在加拿大讀書。

examples.en: The doctor will see you presently, so please take a seat.
examples.zh: 醫生很快就會幫你看診，請先坐下。

examples.en: The teacher gave the class no punishment for the noise.
examples.zh: 老師沒有因為吵鬧而處罰全班。

examples.en: Cleaning the classroom was his punishment for being late.
examples.zh: 打掃教室是他遲到的處罰。

examples.en: A fair punishment should match the mistake.
examples.zh: 公平的處罰應該與過錯相當。

examples.en: She is a qualified teacher with five years of experience.
examples.zh: 她是有五年經驗的合格教師。

examples.en: Only qualified drivers may rent a car here.
examples.zh: 只有合格的駕駛人才能在這裡租車。

examples.en: We are looking for a qualified nurse to join our clinic.
examples.zh: 我們正在找一位合格的護理師加入診所。

examples.en: My uncle rarely eats meat because he prefers fresh vegetables.
examples.zh: 我叔叔很少吃肉，因為他比較喜歡新鮮蔬菜。

examples.en: It rarely snows in southern Taiwan, except in the high mountains.
examples.zh: 台灣南部除了高山地區以外，很少下雪。

examples.en: She rarely complains about her homework, even when it is difficult.
examples.zh: 她很少抱怨功課，即使功課很難也是如此。

examples.en: This magazine has more than ten thousand readers.
examples.zh: 這本雜誌有一萬多名讀者。

examples.en: My little sister is a fast reader.
examples.zh: 我妹妹閱讀速度很快。

examples.en: The library offers books for young readers.
examples.zh: 圖書館提供適合年輕讀者的書。

examples.en: She readily agreed to help us with the party.
examples.zh: 她欣然同意幫我們辦派對。

examples.en: Fresh fruit is readily available at the night market.
examples.zh: 夜市裡很容易買到新鮮水果。

examples.en: He readily admitted that he had made a mistake.
examples.zh: 他很爽快地承認自己犯了錯。

examples.en: Reading before bed helps me fall asleep.
examples.zh: 睡前閱讀幫助我入睡。

examples.en: The teacher gave us a reading list for the summer.
examples.zh: 老師給了我們一份暑假閱讀書單。

examples.en: The thermometer reading was thirty-seven degrees when the nurse checked.
examples.zh: 護理師檢查時，溫度計的讀數是三十七度。

examples.en: The town plans to rebuild the old bridge.
examples.zh: 鎮上打算重建那座老橋。

examples.en: After the fire, they had to rebuild their shop.
examples.zh: 火災後，他們必須重建自己的店。

examples.en: It took two years to rebuild the school.
examples.zh: 重建這所學校花了兩年時間。

examples.en: Are you related to the new teacher?
examples.zh: 你和新來的老師有親戚關係嗎？

examples.en: Please read the related articles on the school website.
examples.zh: 請閱讀學校網站上的相關文章。

examples.en: Stress is closely related to poor sleep.
examples.zh: 壓力與睡眠不佳密切相關。

examples.en: The test was relatively easy this time.
examples.zh: 這次的考試相對簡單。

examples.en: Rent in this area is relatively cheap.
examples.zh: 這一帶的房租相對便宜。

examples.en: Our team is relatively new, but we are learning fast.
examples.zh: 我們的團隊相對較新，但我們學得很快。

examples.en: I called him repeatedly, but he did not answer.
examples.zh: 我打了好幾次電話給他，他都沒接。

examples.en: The teacher repeatedly told us to check our answers.
examples.zh: 老師再三叮嚀我們要檢查答案。

examples.en: The song was played repeatedly on the radio.
examples.zh: 這首歌在廣播中被重複播放。

examples.en: A passport is a basic requirement for traveling abroad.
examples.zh: 護照是出國旅行的基本要求。

examples.en: Students must meet all the requirements before they graduate.
examples.zh: 學生畢業前必須符合所有要求。

examples.en: The job has a requirement of two years of experience.
examples.zh: 這份工作要求兩年經驗。

senses.zh: 焦躁不安的；靜不下來的

examples.en: The children grew restless during the long bus ride.
examples.zh: 孩子們在漫長的公車旅程中變得坐立不安。

examples.en: I felt restless the night before the exam.
examples.zh: 考試前一晚我覺得靜不下心。

examples.en: The restless dog walked around the room all evening.
examples.zh: 那隻靜不下來的狗整個晚上都在房間裡走來走去。

examples.en: The festival gives families a chance to reunite.
examples.zh: 這個節日讓家人有機會團聚。

examples.en: The old friends were happy to reunite after ten years.
examples.zh: 這些老朋友隔了十年重聚，十分開心。

examples.en: The program helped reunite the lost dog with its owner.
examples.zh: 這個計畫幫助走失的狗與主人重逢。

examples.en: Please rewrite your essay and fix the spelling mistakes.
examples.zh: 請重寫你的作文並訂正拼字錯誤。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to rewrite the sentence in the past tense.
examples.zh: 老師要求我們把這個句子改寫成過去式。

examples.en: He had to rewrite the report before the meeting.
examples.zh: 他必須在會議前重寫那份報告。

examples.en: The rider waved to the crowd as she passed.
examples.zh: 騎士經過時向群眾揮手。

examples.en: Every rider on the bus must wear a seat belt.
examples.zh: 公車上的每位乘客都必須繫上安全帶。

examples.en: A young rider led the horse into the field.
examples.zh: 一位年輕的騎士把馬牽進田野。

examples.en: Running is a good way to stay healthy.
examples.zh: 跑步是保持健康的好方法。

examples.en: He goes running in the park every weekend.
examples.zh: 他每個週末都去公園跑步。

examples.en: Running shoes should fit well and feel comfortable.
examples.zh: 跑鞋應該合腳又舒適。

examples.en: We have running water in every room of the hotel.
examples.zh: 我們飯店的每間客房都有自來水。

examples.en: She bought a pair of running shorts for gym class.
examples.zh: 她為體育課買了一條跑步短褲。

examples.en: The running stream cooled our feet on the hot day.
examples.zh: 那條流動的小溪在大熱天讓我們的腳涼快起來。
